versionNeutralJustification: This owned mod changes only descriptions and its feedback UI, not recipes, research or prototype identities. Other added/removed/changed mods require an explicit reference review.

prerequisites.semantics: Exact selected cache prerequisites replace initial declarations; AAI loader edges use current AAI, PyHardmode and Pypostprocessing overrides

unlocks.source: Factory Planner saved final prototype cache, not research progress
unlocks.scope: Saved native recipe index for visible technology unlock effects; all omitted saved recipe IDs classified separately as hidden helpers/disposal/removed combustion or blueprint parameters

provenance.typing: Exact saved recipe/item/fluid names; native item subtypes and placement relationships matched to the separately labelled historical 2.1.19 capture; authored targets additionally checked against current source
provenance.visibility: Saved hidden flag plus current PyIndustry container, PyAlienLife compost and digosaurus source rules; not a live engine/UI capture
limits: The saved Factory Planner cache is a filtered native recipe index, not every engine recipe/effect.
Saved research is a point-in-time force readback, not live progression.
Historical initial technology prerequisites are not used as the current graph.
Native item subtypes and placement links outside authored targets are historical-name matches, not a current resolved-prototype capture.

sources: CircuitConditionScreen_0.6.0/prototypes/entities.lua: item definitions, lamp and programmable-speaker copies

additionalGraphSources.recycling: recycler 2.1.21 data.lua:83, then global processing-unit→advanced-circuit compatibility remap
additionalGraphSources.water_transport: cargo-ships 2.1.8 prototypes/technologies.lua, then pypostprocessing compatibility/cargo-ships.lua removes logistics-2

provenance.publication: Curated prototype relationships only; source-save filesystem locations and player progression excluded. Capture hashes identify provenance, not a bundled save.
